newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via 14-day fixed system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via 14-day fixed system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added temporary reserves to the banking system on Thursday through 14-day fixed system repurchase agreements, a Fed spokeswoman confirmed.
Fed funds were trading at 5-3/16 percent, below the Fed's 5-1/4 pct target for the rate, at the time of the operation.

Due largely to a seasonal jump in currency in circulation that depletes reserves from the banking system, the Fed must add a large amount of reserves to the banking system between now and the end of the year.
